wizard.title: Set up your workspace
wizard.description: Check the server, create your organization and connect an AI model.

phone.title: Open on a computer to finish setup
phone.description: Setup needs a larger screen. Open this address on a computer and carry on there.

unavailable.title: Can't reach the server
unavailable.message: The setup service did not answer. Check that the server is running, then try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to SurefyOS
welcome.description: First, a quick check that this server is ready.

fixes.DATABASE_UNREACHABLE: The database can't be reached. Check the database address in your server settings and that it is running, then check again.
fixes.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: File storage isn't available. Uploads and exports won't work until it is.
fixes.EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED: No email server is set up. Invitations and password reset need one; until then you can copy invite links.
fixes.GPU_NOT_DETECTED: No GPU found. Local models run slowly without one; cloud models are not affected.
fixes.unknown: This check failed. The server log has the details.

welcome.blocked: Fix the database before you continue.

organization.title: Your organization and owner
organization.description: This creates your organization and your account as its Owner, and signs you in.

slugStatus.invalid: Use 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

organization.tokenHelp: This server asks for the setup token from its settings before the first account is created.
organization.tokenInvalid: The setup token is missing or wrong.
organization.name: Your name
organization.ownerEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists on this server.

model.title: Connect an AI model
model.description: Chat needs a model to answer. Add a cloud provider key or a model that runs on your own server. You can do this later.

cloud.title: Cloud provider
cloud.description: Use your own key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others. The key is tested before it is saved.

local.title: Local server
local.description: Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server on your network.

model.skipNote: Without a model, Chat opens with a prompt to connect one.
